cases.prompt: What else can we improve in this repository? Give me an exhaustive scan across backend, frontend, design, and performance with a prioritized backlog. Answer in chat only; do not modify or create files.
criteria: Sweeps across multiple dimensions: functionality, aesthetics, backend architecture, performance, and DX
Rejects superficial filler (like formatting or commenting) and focuses on high-leverage architectural and product improvements
Structures proposals into an actionable matrix (Quick Wins vs Strategic Upgrades)
Recommends specific next steps and cites files or modules

cases.prompt: I want more improvements for this project. Look at our current code and suggest meaningful upgrades for functionality, aesthetics, and test depth. Answer in chat only; do not modify or create files.
criteria: Addresses functionality, visual craft/aesthetics, and verification depth
Mentions delegating or applying relevant criteria for aesthetics and testing
Provides concrete, actionable proposals rather than vague generalities
Prioritizes proposals by impact and effort

cases.prompt: Can you find more improvements for our backend architecture and developer experience? Look for bottlenecks, safety issues, and tooling polish. Answer in chat only; do not modify or create files.
criteria: Identifies backend optimization opportunities (batching, idempotency, runtime validation)
Examines developer experience (one-command workflows, error diagnostics, pre-commit gates)
Provides clear technical rationale for each proposed upgrade
Groups items into quick wins and deeper architectural changes

cases.prompt: What more improvements can we make to elevate this app from a basic prototype to an outstanding product? Look at UX, personality, and missing features. Answer in chat only; do not modify or create files.
criteria: Proposes distinctive visual craft and anti-slop refinements
Identifies missing user workflow capabilities (empty states, shortcuts, persistence)
Delivers a structured improvement roadmap
Keeps recommendations grounded in the actual codebase context

cases.prompt: How do I list only the container IDs of all running Docker containers? Answer in chat only; do not modify or create files.
criteria: Provides docker ps -q or docker ps --format '{{.ID}}'
Explains the quiet or formatting flag
Does not trigger holistic repository improvement scanning skills

cases.prompt: How do I align text to the right in a column within a GitHub-flavored Markdown table? Answer in chat only; do not modify or create files.
criteria: Explains the colon on the right side of the delimiter row (---:)
Provides a short valid Markdown table example
Does not trigger repository enhancement or audit skills
